title: The Met oracle bone object records
scope: Official Met collection and Open Access API records for oracle-bone objects including 42045 / 67.43.14 and 42022 / 18.56.71 with public-domain flags and image URLs.
download_strategy: Use as a public-domain museum object and image-URL metadata workflow sample; do not promote object metadata to paleographic decipherment evidence without scholarly cross-checking.
risk_note: The Met API marks selected objects as public domain, but object metadata and image URLs can be revised and should retain object-level timestamps and source URLs.
research_boundary: source_object_packet_preprocessing_only; source metadata, routes, download logs, package manifests, and field maps are not decipherment, identity, component, inscription, or correspondence conclusions
